content: Good, I can see the Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd file exists. Now let me use FreeCAD to open it, set the appearance to Steel-C10, and save it. First, let me write a Python script that will do this using FreeCAD's API.

function.arguments:
{"script": "cat > /home/user/set_appearance.py << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD
import Part

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

# List all objects in the document to understand what we're working with
print("Objects in document:")
for obj in doc.Objects:
    print(f"  - {obj.Name}: {obj.TypeId}")

# Set appearance to Steel-C10 for all shape objects
# Steel-C10 is a material/appearance setting in FreeCAD
for obj in doc.Objects:
    # Check if object has a ViewProvider (visual representation)
    if hasattr(obj, 'ViewObject'):
        vo = obj.ViewObject
        # Try to set the material/appearance
        if hasattr(vo, 'Material'):
            vo.Material = "Steel-C10"
            print(f"Set Material to Steel-C10 for {obj.Name}")
        elif hasattr(vo, 'ShapeColor'):
            # Alternative: set color if material not available
            print(f"Setting color for {obj.Name}")

# Save the document
FreeCAD.save(doc, "/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Document saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

# Close the document
FreeCAD.close(doc)
print("Done!")
EOF"}

content: I see that the Body has a `ShapeMaterial` property. Also, the Document has a `Material` property. Let me check what values are available and set the ShapeMaterial for the objects:

function.arguments:
{"script": "cat > /home/user/set_material.py << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

print("Setting Steel-C10 material...")

# Set Material on the document level first
if hasattr(doc, 'Material'):
    doc.Material = "Steel-C10"
    print(f"Set document Material to: {doc.Material}")

# Set ShapeMaterial on the Body object
body = doc.getObject("Body")
if body:
    if hasattr(body, 'ShapeMaterial'):
        body.ShapeMaterial = "Steel-C10"
        print(f"Set Body ShapeMaterial to: {body.ShapeMaterial}")

# Also try setting on individual features like Box and Torus
for obj_name in ["Box", "Torus"]:
    obj = doc.getObject(obj_name)
    if obj:
        if hasattr(obj, 'ShapeMaterial'):
            obj.ShapeMaterial = "Steel-C10"
            print(f"Set {obj_name} ShapeMaterial to: {obj.ShapeMaterial}")
        # Also try ViewObject Material
        if hasattr(obj, 'ViewObject'):
            vo = obj.ViewObject
            if hasattr(vo, 'Material'):
                vo.Material = "Steel-C10"
                print(f"Set {obj_name} ViewObject Material to: {vo.Material}")

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("\nDocument saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
print("Done!")
EOF
